entity.name: HQ VAM Analysis of CHIRPS Rainfall Estimates (RFE) 1982-2017

lineage.description: The ICA Sudan 2018 integrated natural shock risk assessment by combining UNEP/UNISDR GAR 2013 baseline hazard data with WFP VAM analysis of CHIRPS rainfall estimates (1982-2017) to classify flood and drought risk at administrative level 2. Risk classifications were derived through empirical analysis of historical rainfall variability and established hazard frameworks, producing categorical risk classes for policy and planning purposes.
